name: Cell Mates
source:
You have been arrested and interrogated for hours. The police are trying to get you to confess to something you didn’t do. Exasperated, the police have put you in a holding cell until they know what to do with you.
It is here that you meet Janus, the most handsome man you have ever seen, and your new cell mate. You now have ot naviogate this strange situation with this stranger, who is very interested in what landed a guy like you here.
